verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Cloudflare Workers run on Cloudflare's global edge network (cloudflare-docs-1, cloudflare-docs-18) and community mentions using Cloudflare Pages for static sites with good results (cloudflare-comm-14), implying edge-served static assets, but no first-party docs in this pack explicitly describe a Workers static-assets/CDN caching feature, cache-control configuration, or edge cache API. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Workers Static Assets binding, cache-control/Cache API usage, and independent benchmarks of CDN caching performance.
